nodes.summary: Along a chain `⋯ ≼ μ₁ ≼ μ₀`, the probability of an increasing event is antitone.
nodes.title: Increasing-event probabilities along a decreasing chain are antitone

nodes.summary: If `ρ ≼ μₙ` for all `n` and `μₙ → ν` weakly, then `ρ(A) ≤ ν(A)` for every increasing clopen event `A`.
nodes.title: Stochastic domination from below passes to weak limits

nodes.summary: Two probability measures on `ConfigSpace E` that agree on clopen sets are equal: the clopen cylinder events form a generating π-system.
nodes.title: Probability measures agreeing on clopen sets are equal

nodes.summary: The weak limit of a decreasing chain gives each increasing clopen event at most the probability any term of the chain gives it.
nodes.title: Weak limit of a decreasing chain is dominated by its terms

nodes.summary: If the probabilities of clopen events converge to `L`, every subsequential weak limit `ξ` satisfies `ξ(A) = L(A)` on clopen `A`.
nodes.title: Subsequential weak limits are determined by clopen-event limits

nodes.summary: A cylinder event of `ConfigSpace E`, determined by finitely many coordinates, is clopen.
nodes.title: Cylinder events are clopen

nodes.summary: The weak limit of an increasing chain gives each increasing clopen event at least the probability any term of the chain gives it.
nodes.title: Weak limit of an increasing chain dominates its terms

nodes.summary: A lower bound on the probabilities of a clopen event along a weakly convergent sequence passes to the limit.
nodes.title: Lower bounds on clopen-event probabilities pass to weak limits

nodes.summary: Along a chain `μ₀ ≼ μ₁ ≼ ⋯`, the probability of an increasing event is monotone.
nodes.title: Increasing-event probabilities along an increasing chain are monotone

nodes.summary: An upper bound on the probabilities of a clopen event along a weakly convergent sequence passes to the limit.
nodes.title: Upper bounds on clopen-event probabilities pass to weak limits

nodes.summary: Under weak convergence, the integral of every bounded continuous function converges.
nodes.title: Weak convergence implies convergence of integrals

nodes.summary: Along a chain `μ₀ ≼ μ₁ ≼ ⋯`, the probability of an increasing clopen event converges to its supremum.
nodes.title: Convergence of increasing-event probabilities along an increasing chain

nodes.summary: Under weak convergence on `ConfigSpace E`, the probability of every clopen event converges (portmanteau theorem).
nodes.title: Portmanteau theorem for clopen events

nodes.summary: If the probability of every clopen event converges along a sequence of probability measures on `ConfigSpace E`, the sequence converges weakly: all subsequential limits (which exist by Prokhorov) agree on clopen sets, hence coincide.
nodes.title: Convergence on clopen events implies weak convergence

nodes.summary: If the integral of every bounded continuous function converges, the measures converge weakly.
nodes.title: Convergence of integrals implies weak convergence

nodes.summary: Weak convergence of a sequence of probability measures on `ConfigSpace E`: convergence in the topology of `ProbabilityMeasure (ConfigSpace E)`, whose open sets are generated by the integrals of bounded continuous functions.
nodes.title: Weak convergence of probability measures on configuration space

nodes.summary: If `μₙ ≼ ρ` for all `n` and `μₙ → ν` weakly, then `ν(A) ≤ ρ(A)` for every increasing clopen event `A`.
nodes.title: Stochastic domination from above passes to weak limits

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
